landing.headline: A calmer way to read, think, and learn.

reader.sampleNotice: Sample text. Paste your own above and press Format.
reader.sampleText: Reading should feel calm, not like a struggle. Nibras reshapes any text. It changes the font, the spacing, the size, and the background into a format that feels right for your eyes and your mind. You set it once, and Nibras remembers, every time you come back.

calm.title: Calmness
calm.subtitle: Your space, before and during reading
calm.settle: Take a moment to settle. Sit comfortably and let your shoulders soften. When you're ready, follow the circle and breathe with it.
calm.doneLine: Nicely done. Return to your reading whenever you like.
calm.settleSpoken: Take a moment to settle. Sit comfortably… and let your shoulders soften. When you're ready, we'll breathe together.
calm.voiceToggleDescription: A calm voice guides your breathing, once you begin.
calm.inhaleCount: Breathe in, one, two, three, four
calm.exhaleCount: Breathe out, one, two, three, four, five, six
calm.countToggleDescription: Listen to the count with each breath.

It is never used to train any AI, and xAI deletes it within 30 days. Nibras itself does not store your voice recording.

mindMaps.title: Mind Maps
mindMaps.subtitle: A mind map turns ideas into a visual diagram: one main idea in the middle, branching out into its parts. The example below turns Nibras's reading techniques into one map you can explore. Turning your own documents into a map needs an AI connection that isn't set up yet.
mindMaps.subtitleLive: A mind map turns ideas into a visual diagram: one main idea in the middle, branching out into its parts. The example below turns Nibras's reading techniques into one map you can explore, or paste your own paragraph to generate a map from it.
mindMaps.needsBackendBody: Mind Maps can only generate a map for Nibras's own techniques right now. Turning your own documents into a map needs an AI connection that isn't set up yet.

guide.title: How to use Nibras
guide.subtitle: A quick, calm walkthrough of what Nibras can do.
guide.readerStep1Body: Paste any text, or open a whole PDF, EPUB, or text file. It's all read and processed on your device.
guide.readerStep2Body: Your text reflows instantly into the font, size, spacing, and background you've set. No extra steps.
guide.settingsStep1Body: Adjust font, text size, line spacing, and background tint until reading feels comfortable.
guide.settingsStep2Body: Saved on this device only, and applied automatically every time you come back.
guide.techniquesStep1Body: Short, evidence-based techniques for reading, comprehension, and focus, grouped into 3 categories.
guide.techniquesStep2Body: Every technique has its own read-aloud button, in English or Arabic.
guide.readingBuddyStep1Body: Press play over any text in the Reader and listen along as you read.
guide.readingBuddyStep2Body: Adjust the speed, and switch between two distinct voices, any time.
guide.mindMapsStep1Body: See a set of the techniques as one example map you can explore.
guide.mindMapsStep2Body: Add notes, rename ideas, add your own branches, and download it as an image.
guide.letterSoundsStep1Body: Tap any letter to hear the sound it makes and see it inside a simple word.
guide.letterSoundsStep2Body: Every letter is here, grouped so similar sounds sit together and are easier to learn.
guide.aiAssistantStep1Body: Get the gist of a text before you read it in full.
guide.aiAssistantStep2Body: Get a plain-language walkthrough of anything that isn't clear.
guide.libraryStep1Body: Open a file or paste text. It's saved to this device.
guide.libraryStep2Body: Group books into named, coloured folders, and pick any one back up where you left off.
guide.calmSpaceStep1Body: Find Calmness in the Reader's header, before or during reading.
guide.calmSpaceStep2Body: Follow a slow inhale-and-exhale rhythm. Pause any time; nothing here is saved.
